notes.title: Meteor Crush VR 1-Hand Mode Update
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

I've update the retail build using the same build as the beta from earlier this week.

Added Feature : 
- 1-Hand Mode 
- Separate Leaderboard for 1-Hand Mode 

You can choose which mode you'll be playing by going to Options and check/uncheck the One Hand part (default is 2-Hand Mode) and Save the Options 

The Controller used when playing is the one with tooltips in the button (the right controller) 

Cheers

notes.title: Meteor Crush VR Beta Branch
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

I've added a beta branch for this game.
Current beta build is 1290689

You can opt into beta branch by right click Meteor Crush VR in Steam App -> Properties -> Betas Tab -> choose "beta" insted of None

Added Feature :
- 1-Hand Mode
- Separate Leaderboard for 1-Hand Mode

You can choose which mode you'll be playing by going to Options and check/uncheck the One Hand part (default is 2-Hand Mode) and Save the Options

The Controller used when playing is the one with tooltips in the button (the right controller)

I'll let the beta branch live for 1 week before moving it to retail build
(sorry, my day job is taking most of my time)

Thank You for your support

Cheers

PS: i suggest using the strap while playing :)

notes.title: Meteor Crush VR Patch 01
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

While i'm trying to beat the highest record this weekend, i noticed a bug in Leaderboard indentation with long Steam username

I've uploaded a new build for this game for that fix

Patch Changelog :
- Fix for Leaderboard indentation
- Update from Unity 5.3.1f1 to Unity 5.4.0f3

Thank You for your support

Cheers
